name: Hui Xian Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Hui Xian Real Estate Investment Trust (Hui Xian REIT) is a Hong Kong collective investment scheme. It is authorized under section 104 of the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Chapter 571 of the Laws of Hong Kong) and its units were listed on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (the HKSE) since 29 April 2011.
